messages.subject: Time recording - March narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi both,

Our records show unposted time for March. Please ensure all narratives are submitted by close of play Friday so we can run the month-end WIP report and issue interim bills. Matters with significant unbilled WIP include WC-00166.

Thanks,
Accounts
